assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for a top-down 2D dungeon game.
Input image 1 is the exact character reference: preserve its identity, outfit, palette, pixel-cluster style, equipment and proportions. It is a native 32 x 64 transparent PNG.
Character: SWORDSMAN with the original burgundy/red cape, hood and armor, and silver sword.
Direction: EVERY FRAME is facing SOUTH toward the viewer (front view). Do not turn into another direction between frames, except the body tuck during a roll. Keep the equipment on the same side as the reference.
Layout is STRICT: EIGHT equal columns, FIVE equal rows, NO gutters, NO margins, NO labels or gridlines. Logical sheet256 x320 pixels. Each cell32 x64 pixels. Deliver an exact nearest-neighbor enlargement of this grid if not native size, ideally1280x1600 (5x). Every figure completely inside its own cell with clear transparency between cells.
Anchor/scale: standing foot contact point at cell(x16,y56), top of hood around y5 to10. Preserve about50-pixel body height for standing frames. No scale drift. Running may lift feet 1-2pixels in flight but keep the implied ground contact consistent. Roll is a compact tucked body near the same ground point, not a miniature standing figure.
ROW1 IDLE,8 frames left-to-right: gentle breathing, slight shoulder/chest change, cape hems sway with staggered folds and settling; seamless loop, stable feet.
ROW2 RUN,8 frames left-to-right: convincing brisk run with alternating planted and airborne legs, clear knee/ankle poses, counter-swinging arms, restrained body lean/bob. Cape trails, billows and curls with delayed follow-through; different cape silhouette across the cycle. Frame8 connects to frame1.
ROW3 ATTACK,8 frames left-to-right: frame1 ready; frames2-3 sword anticipation and torso twist; frames4-5 decisive sword swing across the front; frames6-8 follow-through and return. Show actual arm and sword pose changes; keep swing compact in cell, the game supplies the external slash effect. Cape reacts to the action with secondary motion.
ROW4 ROLL,8 frames left-to-right: crouch/anticipation, shoulder tuck, compact rolling body in frames3-5, unfold/footplant in6-7, return to standing in8. Cape wraps and follows the tumble. Keep this a real tucked dodge roll, not rotating an unchanged standing sprite.
ROW5 BLOCK,8 frames: sword raised defensively across the front, stable braced stance, slightly bent knees, subtle breathing/cape flutter. Loopable held guard. No shield, no new equipment.
Craft: intentional crisp square pixels, limited original indigo-compatible colors, no airbrush, no blur, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, no high-resolution painting, no style change, no halo, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text. Genuine transparent alpha background. Preserve red/green cape color distinction and recognizable face/hood. All forty cells must contain a complete deliberate pose, not duplicated static bodies.
